modalLead: The new themes dress Bookmarks, Inbox, Containers, Glances, Tags and Config, not only the dashboard.

items.text: The new themes also dress the other views. Instrument, Spatial, Riso, Legible, Living, Cartographic and Stationery now frame the panel of Bookmarks, Inbox, Containers, Glances, Tags and Config the way they frame a category on the dashboard.
